authorization: MASTER_EXECUTION.md section 10; replaces prior no-new-method stop, not prior evidence
interpretation: Retrospective development. Historical consumer visibility and label commit availability UNKNOWN. No live/broker alignment or activation.
fit: Expanding valid LIVE_OOS completed rows with label marker, exit, input marker and decision strictly before fit; at least 100. Historical marker maturity is conditional, not proven commit visibility.
calibration: State Ridge only: train base before cutoff minus 2 days; infer later matured inner rows; fit existing bounded affine slope [0,2] with penalty 0.1. No margin selection. Final base trained at cutoff; calibration not fitted on its own in-sample predictions.
information_experiments: UNAVAILABLE: historical event surprise/consensus/news visibility not verified. No synthetic News inputs.
portfolio: NOT_RUN: no independent validated return source. Correlation reported, no weight optimization.
exit: Preserve original label entry+30 minutes target and reconciled exit. No retuning. One pending/position across folds/generations.
daily: UTC calendar days all included. Weekday schedule is an explicit calendar assumption, not verified broker OPEN. MTM uses latest unambiguous quality-valid received quote <= UTC boundary within 20 seconds; missing marks on actual exposure remain NOT_EVALUABLE. No capital/USD assumptions.
acceptance: Research retention only if positive all fixed stresses, >=50 closed trades, >=3 positive folds, positive without best day, all exposure evaluated. Even then no deployment: future untouched validation NOT_RUN and historical timing UNKNOWN.
stop: Execute this finite batch and retain every outcome; no parameter/window/feature additions after scoring. Future methods require a separately frozen batch under Master scope.
